scope: Piano-roll move, resize, pitch, velocity and snap with an all-or-nothing multi-note policy
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: Moving two notes by 24 ticks and 2 semitones updates both; resize and velocity edits are one Undo step each

All or nothing: a selection where one note would start before the clip, end after it, leave pitch 0-127 or drop below one tick is refused with notes and history unchanged; unknown or empty selections and velocities 0/101 are refused
Overlap policy: a note moved onto another of the same pitch is allowed; a move that would make 17 notes sound is refused
A square note moved 37 ticks off the grid at 137 BPM starts at frame 8103 and ends at frame 23869 in the float export (ceil(ticks*30000/137))
Engine: a note moved while sounding finishes its original duration (frames 0..11999), stays silent, then sounds again exactly at frames 48000..59999 of its new position

QML: dragging a note moves it by the snapped change in ticks and semitones; dragging its edge resizes it; a drag past the clip end is refused with a message; Left/Shift+Left, Up/Shift+Up, Snap Off and the velocity box edit the selection; the Undo button reverts
limits: Offscreen platform with synthetic input; no physical audio; dense-drawing performance is #41.
